description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Sett''' [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|pulls in]] enemies at his front and back along the target direction, dealing physical damage and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. ''Facebreaker'' deals 125 – 250 (based on level) '''bonus''' physical damage to [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]].
description.text: Active: Sett pulls in enemies at his front and back along the target direction, dealing physical damage and slowing them by 70% for 0.5 seconds. Facebreaker deals 125 – 250 (based on level) bonus physical damage to monsters.

description2.raw: If ''Facebreaker'' affects at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]] for 1 second upon landing.
description2.text: If Facebreaker affects at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are stunned for 1 second upon landing.

description3.raw: '''''Sett''' becomes [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|unable]] to move or attack for 0.25 seconds after Facebreaker's cast time.''
description3.text: Sett becomes unable to move or attack for 0.25 seconds after Facebreaker's cast time.

notes.text:
Sett will afterwards attempt to basic attack the closest target picked up by Facebreaker, prioritising champions and prioritising those in front of him.
If Facebreaker does not hit an enemy, Haymaker is also unable to be cast for 0.25 seconds after the cast time.
Targets will be pulled towards Sett's location in a straight line and rebound to 150 units from him back in the same line.
The spell indicator is slightly shorter than the actual hitbox' rectangle length, and slightly wider than the width (note that the effects are edge-range from the hitbox rectangle).
Targets protected by spell shields don't count toward the requirement to stun.
Facebreaker's cast generates an additional stack of Hail of Blades despite the ability not resetting his basic attack timer.(bug)
* This is due to the spell incorrectly having the Trait_AttackReset spell tag.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
